# Melvin Jones Repol

> Software Engineer based in Taytay, Rizal, Philippines, focused on building scalable web applications, backend systems, automation tools, developer platforms, and practical AI integrations.

Primary website: https://www.melvinjonesrepol.com

Core focus areas: full-stack web development, backend architecture, DevOps and cloud systems, automation and developer tooling, system design, and AI integration in web applications.

Core technologies: JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, React, Next.js, Laravel, Docker, AWS, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, REST APIs, and cloud architecture.

## Featured Projects

* [DevPulse](https://devpulse.hallofcodes.org): Developer productivity platform that turns coding activity into competitive and shareable leaderboards for individuals and teams.
* [Canis Chatbot](https://www.melvinjonesrepol.com/canis-chatbot): Modular chatbot platform built with TypeScript, Node.js, Prisma, Docker, and integrations for messaging platforms.
* [Point of Sale](https://www.melvinjonesrepol.com/point-of-sale): Lightweight and offline-capable point-of-sale system built with JavaScript and backend APIs.
* [Axleshift Freight Management](https://www.melvinjonesrepol.com/axleshift-freight-management): Full-stack logistics and freight management platform for shipment tracking and operational workflows.
* [Webvium Browser](https://www.webvium.com): Android web browser focused on performance, privacy, customization, and additional browser capabilities.
